label: FFmpeg media adapter
summary: Use FFmpeg and FFprobe for inspectable analysis, reversible renders, interchange verification, and delivery encoding while leaving source recordings untouched.

handoffs.label: Inspect supplied media without changing it
handoffs.intent: Establish format, duration, streams, levels, and timing evidence before choosing a musical operation.
inputs: An immutable supplied recording or a new working render
A song-relative role and musical question
outputs: No replacement or modification of the inspected media
steps: Resolve the exact input and confirm whether it is an immutable raw take or a derived artifact.
Run the narrow EPRS analysis command that answers the stated musical question.
Keep measurements separate from listening decisions and creative approval.
verification: Confirm the source checksum is unchanged.
Confirm analysis names the exact input and does not claim taste, consent, or approval.

handoffs.label: Render a declared derived audio artifact
handoffs.intent: Create a new comp, stem, mix, interchange package, DAW return, or lossless master from an explicit versioned recipe.
inputs: Checksum-bound sources and a versioned EPRS recipe
Explicit sample-rate, bit-depth, timing, processing, and musical intent where relevant
outputs: A new derived file outside recordings/raw
A provenance sidecar and a separate listening-review gate
steps: Use the matching EPRS render command rather than assembling an undeclared FFmpeg command by hand.
Write to a new versioned destination and retain every source.
Listen to the complete result before recording keep, change, stop, or approval.
verification: Verify checksums, source lineage, duration, sample rate, channels, and declared format.
Check for clipping, truncation, sync drift, and unintended silence without treating measurements as approval.

handoffs.label: Assemble a local YouTube delivery file
handoffs.intent: Pair an approved lossless master with either a restrained title card or a reviewed renderer-neutral picture.
inputs: A title-card recipe or a kept H.264 yuv420p progressive BT.709 picture candidate
outputs: A fast-start YouTube MP4 with provenance
No upload, publication, or inferred visual-and-sync approval
steps: Run eprs youtube with the matching v1 or v2 recipe.
For v2, discard embedded guide audio and take audio only from the approved master.
Watch the complete assembled video before recording youtube-approve.
verification: Verify delivery codec, color, duration, audio layout, fast-start metadata, and exact provenance.
For v2, require unchanged picture packet hashes and an audio packet match to the approved-master reference.

preserve: Immutable raw recordings, original videos, native sessions, and every approved lossless source
Working sample rate, bit depth, channel relationships, timing, dynamics, and deliberate silence unless the recipe explicitly changes them
avoid: In-place edits, hidden normalization, implicit resampling, undeclared lossy generations, or automatic creative approval
Treating a technically successful command as permission to publish or as proof that the music works
